name: kyro-qa-assist
description: Read-only QA tester copilot: what changed, what to test, regression risk, defect reports

changes: Resolve optional Kyro 6.5.0 sprint/scope ledger git ranges with read-only commit availability, reachability, and ancestry checks; retain existing fallbacks without Kyro or usable anchors

Disclose dirty closes, detached captures, missing history, non-contiguous or cross-branch sprint selections, and close commits outside their own sprint range; preserve QA authority and evidence labels

Require one hardened Git prefix for all existing and new reads, with subcommand-specific helper suppression, disabled automatic signature checks, forbidden signature format fields, no-op verifier overrides, and separate hardened submodule inspection and explicit unsupported-Git degradation
Resolve nested Kyro workspace roots before tier detection and artifact reads; require QA selection for ambiguous workspaces and keep repository-relative Git paths separate

Initial release: read-only QA tester copilot with evidence labels, three context tiers (full Kyro, Kyro files, git-only), intent-gated assets for sources, oracles, regression, test design, and defect reports
